title: krillinai/OpenCreator
friendlyTitle: OpenCreator puts many AI media tools in one workspace
summary: OpenCreator, formerly KrillinAI, is an open-source workspace that brings video downloading, transcription, translation, dubbing, image and voice generation, avatars and agent-assisted editing into one creator tool. The actively updated repository had about 12,900 stars when reviewed.
friendlySummary: OpenCreator combines video translation, dubbing, images, voices, avatars and editing in one open-source tool.
whyItMatters: Creators can use it to assemble multilingual video and social-media workflows locally instead of moving files through several separate services. Its broad feature set means users should inspect model-provider costs, licences and output quality for each stage.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can reduce the number of apps needed for a media project. Check service costs and the quality of each output before publishing.
